boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase ways for SUNY Oneonta students to spend time together on campus and nearby.

cards.title: Pick a game at Dragon’s Lair
cards.subtitle: Hunt Union
cards.notes: Meet on Hunt Union’s first floor, choose from the supplied console, board, or card games, and settle in for a low-key group session.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused lounge with games already on hand.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies Dragon’s Lair as a free lounge for students with retro, modern, board, and card games.
cards.access_notes: Made primarily for SUNY Oneonta students; located just inside the Hunt Union first-floor lobby entrance.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset together
cards.subtitle: Hunt Union, Room 126
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a calm pause between classes; the room supports quiet contemplation, meditation, prayer, or simply a few unplugged minutes.
cards.short_summary: An inclusive campus room for individual or small-group reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta says the Interfaith Prayer & Reflection Space is for individuals and small groups to contemplate, meditate, pray, or take quiet time.
cards.source_title: SUNY Oneonta Opens Interfaith Prayer & Reflection Space
cards.access_notes: Located on Hunt Union’s main floor in Room 126; no admission or purchase is described.

cards.title: Catch a student planetarium show
cards.subtitle: SUNY Oneonta campus
cards.notes: Check the current show schedule, reserve a seat if needed, and bring your group for a short campus astronomy program.
cards.short_summary: Campus planetarium shows are free to SUNY Oneonta students.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that planetarium-show tickets are free for SUNY Oneonta students.
cards.access_notes: Tickets are free for SUNY Oneonta students; reserve online ahead when available because walk-in seating is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Walk the Martin-Mullen Gallery
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Start at the Fine Arts Center’s Ravine Parkway entrance and take in the current exhibition together; check the gallery calendar before going.
cards.short_summary: A free campus gallery for student, faculty, and visiting-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists free admission for its galleries and identifies Martin-Mullen Gallery as a Fine Arts Center exhibition space.
cards.access_notes: General gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed between exhibitions and by appointment during recesses.

cards.title: See what’s on in Project Space
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Center, Room 165
cards.notes: Head behind Martin-Mullen into the classroom hallway and browse the smaller gallery’s solo or group show with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free, intimate gallery featuring student and professional work.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists free gallery admission and locates Project Space Gallery in Room 165 of the Fine Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: General gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm that an exhibition is on view before visiting.

cards.title: Find the Open Space mural
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Center courtyard hallway
cards.notes: Use the hallway between Martin-Mullen and the Fine Arts Center courtyard for a quick art stop and a conversation around the current mural.
cards.short_summary: A free hallway gallery centered on a large mural wall.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists free gallery admission and describes Open Space Gallery as a Fine Arts Center hallway gallery with an annual mural program.
cards.access_notes: Enter the Fine Arts Center from Ravine Parkway; the gallery is just past Martin-Mullen. Check exhibition timing before going.

cards.title: Browse Yager’s five galleries
cards.subtitle: Hartwick College, Oneonta
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit with friends and move through the museum’s art and cultural collections, including exhibitions drawn from regional and Indigenous material.
cards.short_summary: A nearby college museum with free admission for all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Hartwick College states that admission to the Yager Museum of Art & Culture is free to all visitors.
cards.access_notes: The museum’s posted summer schedule is Wednesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm current hours before traveling.

cards.title: Choose books for a shared read
cards.subtitle: Milne Library
cards.notes: Browse the stacks together and, if eligible, apply at the circulation desk for a Community Borrower card to take selected materials home.
cards.short_summary: A campus library visit that can include no-charge community borrowing.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta says Community Borrower cards are issued at Milne Library with no charge to the borrower.
cards.access_notes: Community borrowers must complete the application process; ask the circulation desk about eligibility and current hours.

cards.title: Plan a permitted College Camp overnight
cards.subtitle: 119 Hoffman Road
cards.notes: Coordinate a small group, get the required permit from the Outdoor Resource Center, and follow College Camp rules for a simple outdoor overnight.
cards.short_summary: College Camp camping uses a free permit obtained before the trip.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that all College Camp campers need a free camping permit from the Director of Outdoor Programs.
cards.access_notes: Obtain the free permit in advance from the Outdoor Resource Center in Hulbert Hall and comply with College Camp regulations.

cards.title: Book a free writing consult
cards.subtitle: Student Learning Center, Milne Library
cards.notes: Schedule a session, bring a draft, and invite a classmate to compare feedback afterward; appointments are held in the Student Learning Center unless requested online.
cards.short_summary: No-charge one-on-one writing support in Milne Library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that signing up for a Writing Assistance appointment with a writing consultant is free.
cards.source_title: Writing Assistance | SUNY Oneonta Student Learning Center
cards.access_notes: Use a SUNY Oneonta login to book; in-person appointments are normally in the Student Learning Center on Milne Library’s second floor.

warnings: Gallery visits depend on the exhibition calendar; confirm that a show is on view before going.
